up: Retrieve activity details for IC50 bioactivity values in nM against target CHEMBL3717 (Hepatocyte growth factor receptor). The compound set must include CHEMBL2105717 (CABOZANTINIB) and all its salts/parent forms by traversing molecule_hierarchy: find the parent_molregno for CHEMBL2105717, then select all molecules where parent_molregno matches that parent or molregno equals the parent. Return exactly these columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (COALESCE of pubmed_id and doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Do not apply any row limits.
sql:
WITH base_mol AS (
  SELECT molregno FROM molecule_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2105717'
),
related_mols AS (
  SELECT molregno FROM molecule_hierarchy WHERE parent_molregno = (SELECT molregno FROM base_mol)
  UNION
  SELECT molregno FROM base_mol
)
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.activity_comment,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN related_mols rm ON a.molregno = rm.molregno
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON rm.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON rm.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3717'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
